input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, messaging domain. It serves User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include message. Core business data revolves around FormattedMessage. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
